title: Nanopore Direct RNA Sequencing
author: Opentrons
materials: Pause for user to thermocycle sample plate.

steps.title: Distribute wash buffer
steps.instruction: Evenly split wash buffer between wells A5 and A6 on slot 5.

steps.title: Prepare Mix 1
steps.instruction: Make Mix 1 according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Add Mix 1 to RNA tubes
steps.instruction: Distribute the prepared Mix 1 into each RNA tube.

steps.title: Prepare Mix 2
steps.instruction: Make Mix 2 according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Add Mix 2 to RNA tubes
steps.instruction: Distribute the prepared Mix 2 into each RNA tube.

steps.title: Add reverse transcriptase
steps.instruction: Add the reverse transcriptase reagent to each tube.

steps.title: Transfer samples to plate
steps.instruction: Move the reaction mixture from the tubes onto the designated plate.

steps.title: Thermocycle plate
steps.instruction: Pause for the user to run the thermocycling program on the plate.

steps.title: Transfer beads to plate
steps.instruction: Add the magnetic beads to each well of the plate.

steps.title: Bead mix and aspirate cycles
steps.instruction: Mix the samples, aspirate the mixture into a tip, incubate at the top of the well for 1 minute, and repeat this sequence 4 times.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the sample into a tip.
Incubate at the well top for 1 minute.
Repeat the above three actions a total of 4 times.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Add ethanol
steps.instruction: Add ethanol to each well as specified by the protocol.

steps.title: Remove ethanol supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the ethanol supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Add nuclease‑free water
steps.instruction: Add nuclease‑free water to each well.

steps.title: Transfer to fresh column
steps.instruction: Move the eluate to a fresh column, specifically column 3.

steps.title: Prepare and distribute Mix 3
steps.instruction: Make Mix 3 and distribute it to the appropriate wells.

substeps.instruction: Make Mix 3 according to the kit instructions.
Distribute Mix 3 to the designated wells.

steps.title: Second bead addition
steps.instruction: Transfer beads to the plate for the second binding step.

steps.title: Remove second supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant after the second bead binding.

steps.title: Add wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add wash buffer to each well as the final cleaning step.
